text:
cleo_fin: Heads-up: preparing a staggered rollout for PRICESET-APRIL (7% cohort) next Tue 09:00 PT. This is A/B style but with special grandfathering carveouts. Need to lock rollback triggers and invoice reconciliation steps. @ben_ops @sam_billing @anya_cs please chime in.
ben_ops: Acknowledged. We'll do a weight-based rollout with a 90min canary and a 3-hr extended monitoring window. Recommend automatic 0% weight if any of these fire: invoice delta >6% in canary accounts, or meter_id mismatch rate >0.4%.
sam_billing: From billing POV: main risks are new meter ids and tier boundary shifts. Request vendor output + mapping file, plus a checksum and an example of tiered thresholds. We'll run a dry invoice against 10 exempt enterprise accounts + 40 PAYG samples.
anya_cs: CS: confirm the grandfathering list (we've 10 enterprise accounts + 2 partners). Any of those must be excluded. Also want a templated customer note in case we need to pause for customers.
vendor_mike: I'll provide TSV and JSON versions: s3://vendor-exports/priceset_april_224999.tsv and priceset_april_224999.json. Posting sha256 for TSV after upload. Fields: sku,meter_id,unit_cents,tier_cutoffs.
cleo_fin: Action list: 1) @vendor_mike upload mappings + sha256 2) @sam_billing run simulated invoice + add `grandfather_exempt` flag 3) @ben_ops add router guard + PD alert 4) @anya_cs confirm exempt list and draft comms.
ben_ops: Technical detail: we'll implement a parity check that fetches mapping from the price migration table for the first 300 routed requests and increment metric `price.migration.parity_failures`. If parity_failures >1 in first 10m, PD page. Also adding runbook link to ops doc.
sam_billing: Sim plan: ingest vendor file -> build `price_migration_vAPR` table with `grandfather_exempt` boolean and `source_sha256`. Then run: ```sql
-- reconcile snippet
SELECT account_id, meter_id, ROUND(SUM(amount_cents)/100.0,2) total_usd
FROM simulated_line_items
WHERE run_tag='apr_canary' GROUP BY account_id;
```
anya_cs: I've uploaded the exempt ID list to Drive: https://drive.redwood/drive/1Zp... Please ensure those IDs are excluded. CS will sign off for go if simulated invoices show zero charges at NEW_PRICE for those IDs.
vendor_mike: TSV uploaded s3://vendor-exports/priceset_april_224999.tsv sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f6... JSON uploaded too. LMK if you need CSV.
billing-bot: [automated] Billing status: backlog 19, avg process 11s. Last reconciliation job succeeded 2026-03-21T02:00Z.
sam_billing: Imported mappings and added `grandfather_exempt`. Running simulated invoice now against the target cohort at 2x sample. Will post results to Drive in ~90m.
ben_ops: Also recommend disabling automated invoice export to downstream systems during the canary window to avoid partial snapshots. We'll re-enable after 3hr hold if healthy.
cleo_fin: Proposed rollback criteria: - any exempt account billed at NEW_PRICE OR - aggregate invoice delta >5% across canary vs baseline over 20m OR - parity_failures >0.3% in first 15m. If any triggers, immediate 0% weight and PD incident.
anya_cs: CS will hold the go/no-go. We'll verify exempt list and simulated invoice run. If anything fails we escalate to support and delay rollout.
sam_billing: Simulated invoice results uploaded: No exempt acct billed. Random PAYG sample shows 0.8% variance, mostly due to rounding in tiered buckets. Reconcile report: https://drive.redwood/drive/1Yy...
cleo_fin: Thanks — I'll publish a final readiness post 07:30 PT on rollout day. :white_check_mark:
